sections.label: Book 29
sections.name: Supplementary texts of the Horse Sacrifice

verses.sa: समिद्धो अञ्जन् कृदरं मतीनां घृतमग्ने मधुमत्पिन्वमानः। वाजी वहन् वाजिनं जातवेदो देवानां वक्षि प्रियमा सधस्थम्॥
verses.tr: samiddho añjan kṛdaraṃ matīnāṃ ghṛtamagne madhumatpinvamānaḥ vājī vahan vājinaṃ jātavedo devānāṃ vakṣi priyamā sadhastham
verses.en: Decking the treasure-house of prayers, O Agni, enkindled, pouring forth sweet-tasted butter, Swift-moving, bearing curd, O Jatavedas, bear what they love to the Gods habitation.

verses.sa: घृतेनाञ्जन्त्सं पथो देवयानान् प्रजानन् वाज्यप्येतु देवान्। अनु त्वा सप्ते प्रदिशः सचन्तां स्वधामस्मै यजमानाय धेहि॥
verses.tr: ghṛtenāñjantsaṃ patho devayānān prajānan vājyapyetu devān anu tvā sapte pradiśaḥ sacantāṃ svadhāmasmai yajamānāya dhehi
verses.en: Balming the paths that lead to heaven with fatness, let the Steed go unto the Gods well-knowing. Courser, the Quarters of the sky attend thee! Bestow thou food upon this Sacrificer.

verses.sa: ईड्यश्चासि वन्द्यश्च वाजिन्नाशुश्चासि मेध्यश्च सप्ते। अग्निष्ट्वा देवैर्वसुभिः सजोषाः प्रीतं वह्निं वहतु जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: īḍyaścāsi vandyaśca vājinnāśuścāsi medhyaśca sapte agniṣṭvā devairvasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ prītaṃ vahniṃ vahatu jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Thou, Steed, art meet for laud and veneration; swift, fit for sacrifice art thou, O Courser. In concert with the Gods and Vasus Agni Omniscient waft thee a contented bearer!

verses.sa: स्तीर्णं बर्हिः सुष्टरीमा जुषाणोरु पृथु प्रथमानं पृथिव्याम्। देवेभिर्युक्तमदितिः सजोषाः स्योनं कृण्वाना सुविते दधातु॥
verses.tr: stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ suṣṭarīmā juṣāṇoru pṛthu prathamānaṃ pṛthivyām devebhiryuktamaditiḥ sajoṣāḥ syonaṃ kṛṇvānā suvite dadhātu
verses.en: Pleased with much Sacred Grass which we have scattered wide spread upon the earth, a pleasant carpet. Joined with the Gods may Aditi, accordant, bestowing bliss award it happy fortune.

verses.sa: एता उ वः सुभगा विश्वरूपा वि पक्षोभिः श्रयमाणा उदातैः। ऋष्वाः सतीः कवषः शुम्भमाना द्वारो देवीः सुप्रायणा भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: etā u vaḥ subhagā viśvarūpā vi pakṣobhiḥ śrayamāṇā udātaiḥ ṛṣvāḥ satīḥ kavaṣaḥ śumbhamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā bhavantu
verses.en: May these your Doors divine that wear all colours, auspicious, with uplifted leaves unfolding, Lofty and closely fitted and sonorous, rich in adornment, offer easy passage.

verses.sa: अन्तरा मित्रावरुणा चरन्ती मुखं यज्ञानामभि संविदाने। उषासा वां सुहिरण्ये सुशिल्पे ऋतस्य योनाविह सादयामि॥
verses.tr: antarā mitrāvaruṇā carantī mukhaṃ yajñānāmabhi saṃvidāne uṣāsā vāṃ suhiraṇye suśilpe ṛtasya yonāviha sādayāmi
verses.en: Your two Dawns rich in gold and varied colour, travelling on twixt Varuna and Mitra, Acquainted with the face of sacrifices, I settle here within the home of Order.

verses.sa: प्रथमा वां सरथिना सुवर्णा देवौ पश्यन्तौ भुवनानि विश्वा। अपिप्रयं चोदना वां मिमाना होतारा ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता॥
verses.tr: prathamā vāṃ sarathinā suvarṇā devau paśyantau bhuvanāni viśvā apiprayaṃ codanā vāṃ mimānā hotārā jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā
verses.en: Your two chief Hotars have I pleased, bright-coloured, borne on one car, Gods who behold all creatures. Those who prepare your rules and ordinances and make you see the light by their direction.

verses.sa: आदित्यैर्नो भारती वष्टु यज्ञं सरस्वती सह रुद्रैर्न आवीत्। इडोपहूता वसुभिः सजोषा यज्ञं नो देवीरमृतेषु धत्त॥
verses.tr: ādityairno bhāratī vaṣṭu yajñaṃ sarasvatī saha rudrairna āvīt iḍopahūtā vasubhiḥ sajoṣā yajñaṃ no devīramṛteṣu dhatta
verses.en: Bharati with Adityas love our worship! Sarasvati with Rudras be our helper, And I in accord, invoked with Vasus! Goddesses, place our rite among the Immortals.

verses.sa: त्वष्टा वीरं देवकामं जजान त्वष्टुरर्वा जायत आशुरश्वः। त्वष्टेदं विश्वं भुवनं जजान बहोः कर्तारमिह यक्षि होतः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā vīraṃ devakāmaṃ jajāna tvaṣṭurarvā jāyata āśuraśvaḥ tvaṣṭedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna bahoḥ kartāramiha yakṣi hotaḥ
verses.en: The God-devoted son Tvashtar produces: from Tvashtar springs to life your fleet-foot Courser. Tvashtar gave being to this All about us. Priest, worship here the mighty work achiever.

verses.sa: अश्वो घृतेन त्मन्या समक्त उप देवाँ२ ऋतुशः पाथ एतु। वनस्पतिर्देवलोकं प्रजानन्नग्निना हव्या स्वदितानि वक्षत्॥
verses.tr: aśvo ghṛtena tmanyā samakta upa devāṃ2 ṛtuśaḥ pātha etu vanaspatirdevalokaṃ prajānannagninā havyā svaditāni vakṣat
verses.en: Let the Steed seek his home, and balmed with butter go of himself unto the Gods in season. To the Gods' world Vanaspati, well-knowing, bear our oblations which the Are has tasted!

verses.sa: प्रजापतेस्तपसा वावृधानः सद्यो जातो दधिषे यज्ञमग्ने। स्वाहाकृतेन हविषा पुरोगा याहि साध्या हविरदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: prajāpatestapasā vāvṛdhānaḥ sadyo jāto dadhiṣe yajñamagne svāhākṛtena haviṣā purogā yāhi sādhyā haviradantu devāḥ
verses.en: Thou, waxing by Prajapati's strong fervour, born quickly, guardest sacrifice, O Agni. With consecrated offering go, preceding, and let the Sadhyas, Gods, eat our oblation.

verses.sa: यदक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान उद्यन्त्समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात्। श्येनस्य पक्षा हरिणस्य बाहू उपस्तुत्यं महि जातं ते अर्वन्॥
verses.tr: yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan
verses.en: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or cloudy vapour, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is high and must be lauded.

verses.sa: यमेन दत्तं त्रित एनमायुनगिन्द्र एणं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत्। गन्धर्वो अस्य रशनामगृभ्णात् सूरादश्वं वसवो निरतष्ट॥
verses.tr: yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindra eṇaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat gandharvo asya raśanāmagṛbhṇāt sūrādaśvaṃ vasavo nirataṣṭa
verses.en: This Steed, bestowed by Yama, Trita harnessed, and Indra was the first to mount and ride him. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.

verses.sa: असि यमो अस्यादित्यो अर्वन्नसि त्रितो गुह्येन व्रतेन। असि सोमेन समया विपृक्त आहुस्ते त्रीणि दिवि बन्धनानि॥
verses.tr: asi yamo asyādityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni
verses.en: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Aditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. From Soma thou art thoroughly divided. They say there are three bonds in heaven that hold thee.

verses.sa: त्रीणि त आहुर्दिवि बन्धनानि त्रीण्यप्सु त्रीण्यन्तः समुद्रे। उतेव मे वरुणश्छन्त्स्यर्वन् यत्रा त आहुः परमं जनित्रम्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre uteva me varuṇaśchantsyarvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram
verses.en: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven to bind thee, To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birthplace.

verses.sa: इमा ते वाजिन्नवमार्जनानीमा शफानां सनितुर्निधाना। अत्रा ते भद्रा रशना अपश्यमृतस्य या अभिरक्षन्ति गोपाः॥
verses.tr: imā te vājinnavamārjanānīmā śaphānāṃ saniturnidhānā atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyamṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ
verses.en: Here, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee; here are the traces of thy hooves as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.

verses.sa: आत्मानं ते मनसारादजानामवो दिवा पतयन्तं पतङ्गम्। शिरो अपश्यं पथिभिः सुगेभिररेणुभिर्जेहमानं पतत्रि॥
verses.tr: ātmānaṃ te manasārādajānāmavo divā patayantaṃ pataṅgam śiro apaśyaṃ pathibhiḥ sugebhirareṇubhirjehamānaṃ patatri
verses.en: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit, a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by patas unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.

verses.sa: अत्रा ते रूपमुत्तममपश्यं जिगीषमाणमिष आ पदे गोः। यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानडादिद् ग्रसिष्ठ ओषधीरजीगः॥
verses.tr: atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍādid grasiṣṭha oṣadhīrajīgaḥ
verses.en: Here I beheld thy form matchless in beauty, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Whene'er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the herbs, most greedy eater.

verses.sa: अनु त्वा रथो अनु मर्यो अर्वन्ननु गावोऽनु भगः कनीनाम्। अनु व्रातासस्तव सख्यमीयुरनु देवा ममिरे वीर्यं ते॥
verses.tr: anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvannanu gāvo'nu bhagaḥ kanīnām anu vrātāsastava sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te
verses.en: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have followed.

verses.sa: हिरण्यशृङ्गोऽयो अस्य पादा मनोजवा अवर इन्द्र आसीत्। देवा इदस्य हविरद्यमायन् यो अर्वन्तं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt devā idasya haviradyamāyan yo arvantaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat
verses.en: His horns are golden and his feet are iron. Less fleet than he, though swift as thought, was Indra. The Gods came only to the oblation-banquet of him who mounted first of all the Courser.

verses.sa: ईर्मान्तासः सिलिकमध्यमासः सं शूरणासो दिव्यासो अत्याः। हसा इव श्रेणिशो यतन्ते यदाक्षिषुर्दिव्यमज्ममश्वाः॥
verses.tr: īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ hasā iva śreṇiśo yatante yadākṣiṣurdivyamajmamaśvāḥ
verses.en: Symmetrical in flank, with rounded haunches, mettled like heroes, the celestial Coursers Put forth their strength like swans in lengthened order when they, the Steeds, have reached the heavenly causeway.

verses.sa: तव शरीरं पतयिष्ण्वर्वन्तव चित्तं वात इव ध्रजीमान्। तव शृङ्गाणि विष्ठिता पुरुत्रारण्येषु जर्भुराणा चरन्ति॥
verses.tr: tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvantava cittaṃ vāta iva dhrajīmān tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti
verses.en: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions; they move with restless beat in wildernesses.

verses.sa: उप प्रागाच्छसनं वाज्यर्वा देवद्रीचा मनसा दीध्यानः। अजः पुरो नीयते नाभिरस्यानु पश्चात्कवयो यन्ति रेभाः॥
verses.tr: upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājyarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścātkavayo yanti rebhāḥ
verses.en: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him: the sages and the singers follow after.

verses.sa: उप प्रागात्परमं यत्सधस्थमर्वाँ२ अच्छा पितरं मातरं च। अद्या देवाञ्जुष्टतमो हि गम्या अथा शास्ते दाशुषे वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: upa prāgātparamaṃ yatsadhasthamarvāṃ2 acchā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.en: The Steed is come i unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who worships.

verses.sa: समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान् यजसि जातवेदः। आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान्त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ
verses.en: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods, a God, O Jatavedas. Wealthy in friends! observant, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient envoy, full of wisdom.

verses.sa: तनूनपात्पथ ऋतस्य यानान्मध्वा समञ्जन्त्स्वदया सुजिह्व। मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन् देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः॥
verses.tr: tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ
verses.en: Tanunapat, fair-tongued, with sweet mead balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sa: नराशंसस्य महिमानमेषामुप स्तोषाम यजतस्य यज्ञैः। ये सुक्रतवः शुचयो धियन्धाः स्वदन्ति देवा उभयानि हव्या॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsasya mahimānameṣāmupa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyandhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā
verses.en: With sacrifice to these we with laudations will honour holy Narasamsa's greatness—To these the pure, most wise, the thought-inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.

verses.sa: आजुह्वान ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चा याह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः। त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान्यक्षीषितो यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān
verses.en: Invoked, deserving laud and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O vigorous One, the Gods' Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sa: प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम्। व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम्॥
verses.tr: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam
verses.en: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe the earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sa: व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः। देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः॥
verses.tr: vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ
verses.en: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy access.

verses.sa: आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ। दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने॥
verses.tr: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne
verses.en: Pouring sweet dews, let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station—Lofty, celestial Dames, with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sa: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै। प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā
verses.en: Come the two chief celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship, As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction!

verses.sa: आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विडा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती। तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वती स्वपसः सदन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu
verses.en: Let Bharati come quickly to our worship, and Ida showing like a human being. So let Sarasvati and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sa: य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा। तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान् देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān
verses.en: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed today God Tvashtar, thou who knowest. Even him who framed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sa: उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन् देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि। वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन॥
verses.tr: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena
verses.en: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspati, the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with mead and butter.

verses.sa: सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत् पुरोगाः। अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavat purogāḥ asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ
verses.en: Agni as soon as he was bom made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to the true Priest's voice and guidance.

verses.sa: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे। समुषद्भिरजायथाः॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
verses.en: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men! where form was not. Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sa: जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकं यद्वर्मी याति समदामुपस्थे। अनाविद्धया तन्वा जय त्वं स त्वा वर्मणो महिमा पिपर्तु॥
verses.tr: jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu
verses.en: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with un wounded body: so let the thickness of thine armour save thee.

verses.sa: धन्वना गा धन्वनाऽऽजिं जयेम धन्वना तीव्राः समदो जयेम। धनुः शत्रोरपकामं कृणोति धन्वना सर्वाः प्रदिशो जयेम॥
verses.tr: dhanvanā gā dhanvanā''jiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema dhanuḥ śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema
verses.en: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.

verses.sa: वक्ष्यन्तीवेदा गनीगन्ति कर्णं प्रियं सखायं परिषस्वजाना। योषेव शिङ्क्ते वितताधि धन्वञ्ज्या इयं समने पारयन्ती॥
verses.tr: vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī
verses.en: Close to his ear, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman—this Bow-string that preserves us in the combat.

verses.sa: ते आचरन्ती समनेव योषा मातेव पुत्रं बिभृतामुपस्थे। अप शत्रून् विध्यतां संविदाने आर्त्नी इमे विष्फुरन्ती अमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe apa śatrūn vidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān
verses.en: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.

verses.sa: बह्वीनां पिता बहुरस्य पुत्रश्चिश्चा कृणोति समनावगत्य। इषुधिः सङ्का पृतनाश्च सर्वाः पृष्ठे निनद्धो जयति प्रसूतः॥
verses.tr: bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya iṣudhiḥ saṅkā pṛtanāśca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ
verses.en: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver shes all opposing bands and armies.

verses.sa: रथे तिष्ठन् नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्र-यत्र कामयते सुषारथिः। अभीशूनां महिमानं पनायत मनः पश्चादनु यच्छन्ति रश्मयः॥
verses.tr: rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatra-yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścādanu yacchanti raśmayaḥ
verses.en: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides bis strong Horses on witherso'er he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives.

verses.sa: तीव्रान् घोषान् कृण्वते वृषपाणयोऽश्वा रथेभिः सह वाजयन्तः। अवक्रामन्तः प्रपदैरमित्रान् क्षिणन्ति शत्रूँ१ रनपव्ययन्तः॥
verses.tr: tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ avakrāmantaḥ prapadairamitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūṃ1 ranapavyayantaḥ
verses.en: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, ts, showing forth their vigour. With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.

verses.sa: रथवाहणं हविरस्य नाम यत्रायुधं निहितमस्य वर्म। तत्रा रथमुप शग्मं सदेम विश्वाहा वयं सुमनस्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: rathavāhaṇaṃ havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma tatrā rathamupa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ
verses.en: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.

verses.sa: स्वादुषंसदः पितरो वयोधाः कृच्छ्रेश्रितः शक्तीवन्तो गभीराः। चित्रसेना इषुबला अमृध्राः सतोवीरा उरवो व्रातसाहाः॥
verses.tr: svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ
verses.en: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble. Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणासः पितरः सोम्यासः शिवे नो द्यावापृथिवी अनेहसा। पूषा नः पातु दुरितादृतावृधो रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā pūṣā naḥ pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: The Brahmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pushan! guard us strengtheners of Law! let not the evil-wisher master us.

verses.sa: सुपर्णं वस्ते मृगो अस्या दन्तो गोभिः सन्नद्धा पतति प्रसूता। यत्रा नरः सं च वि च द्रवन्ति तत्रास्मभ्यमिषवः शर्म यंसन्॥
verses.tr: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ sannaddhā patati prasūtā yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan
verses.en: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the arrows shelter and protect us.

verses.sa: ऋजीते परि वृङ्धि नोऽश्मा भवतु नस्तनूः। सोमो अधि ब्रवीतु नोऽदितिः शर्म यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ somo adhi bravītu no'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu
verses.en: Avoid as thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.

verses.sa: आ जङ्घन्ति सान्वेषां जघनाँ२ उप जिघ्नते। अश्वाजनि प्रचेतसोऽश्वान्त्समत्सु चोदय॥
verses.tr: ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanāṃ2 upa jighnate aśvājani pracetaso'śvāntsamatsu codaya
verses.en: He lays his blows upon their backs, He deals his strokes upon their thighs. Thou Whip who urgest horses, drive sagacious chargers in the fray.

verses.sa: अहिरिव भोगैः पर्येति बाहुं ज्याया हेतिं परिबाधमानः। हस्तघ्नो विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान् पुमान् पुमांसं परि पातु विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṃsaṃ pari pātu viśvataḥ
verses.en: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.

verses.sa: वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः। गोभिः सन्नद्धो असि वीडयस्वास्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि॥
verses.tr: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ gobhiḥ sannaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni
verses.en: Lord of the Wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero. Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

verses.sa: दिवः पृथिव्याः पर्योज उद्भृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः पर्याभृतं सहः। अपामोज्मानं परि गोभिरावृतमिन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज॥
verses.tr: divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja
verses.en: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः। सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय॥
verses.tr: indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya
verses.en: Thou bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,—As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O. Godlike Chariot, these oblations.

verses.sa: उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते मनुतां विष्ठितं जगत्। स दुन्दुभे सजूरिन्द्रेण देवैर्दूराद्दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn
verses.en: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

verses.sa: आ क्रन्दय बलमोजो न आधा निष्टनिहि दुरिता बाधमानः। अप प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दुच्छुना इत इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिरसि वीडयस्व॥
verses.tr: ā krandaya balamojo na ādhā niṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḍayasva
verses.en: Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.

verses.sa: आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमद्दुन्दुभिर्वावदीति। समश्वपर्णाश्चरन्ति नो नरोऽस्माकमिन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु॥
verses.tr: āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu
verses.en: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our oarwarriors, Indra, be triumphant.

verses.sa: आग्नेयः कृष्णग्रीवः सारस्वती मेषी बभ्रुः सौम्यः पौष्णः श्यामः शितिपृष्ठो बार्हस्पत्यः शिल्पो वैश्वदेव ऐन्द्रोऽरुणो मारुतः कल्माष ऐन्द्राग्नः संहितोऽधोरामः सावित्रो वारुणः कृष्ण एकशितिपात्पेत्वः॥
verses.tr: āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ sārasvatī meṣī babhruḥ saumyaḥ pauṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyaḥ śilpo vaiśvadeva aindro'ruṇo mārutaḥ kalmāṣa aindrāgnaḥ saṃhito'dhorāmaḥ sāvitro vāruṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ekaśitipātpetvaḥ
verses.en: The black-necked victim belongs to Agni; the ewe to Sarasvati; the brown victim is Soma's; the dusky Foshan's; the white-backed is Brihaspati's; the dappled belongs to the All-Gods; the red to Indra; the spotted to the Maruts; the strong-bodied to Aindragna; one with white marks below to Savitar; to Varuna a black ram with one white foot.

verses.sa: अग्नयेऽनीकवते रोहिताञ्जिरनड्वानधोरामौ सावित्रौ पौष्णौ रजतनाभी वैश्वदेवौ पिशङ्गौ तूपरौ मारुतः कल्माष आग्नेयः कृष्णोऽजः सारस्वती मेषी वारुणः पेत्वः॥
verses.tr: agnaye'nīkavate rohitāñjiranaḍvānadhorāmau sāvitrau pauṣṇau rajatanābhī vaiśvadevau piśaṅgau tūparau mārutaḥ kalmāṣa āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇo'jaḥ sārasvatī meṣī vāruṇaḥ petvaḥ
verses.en: To Agni Anikavan is sacrificed a red-marked ox; two with white spots below are for Savitar; two with silvery navels for Pushan; two yellow hornless he-goats for the All-Gods; a spotted one for the Maruts; the black-faced he-goat is Agni's; the ewe is Sarasvati's; the ram is Varuna's.

verses.sa: अग्नये गायत्राय त्रिवृते राथन्तरायाष्टाकपाल इन्द्राय त्रैष्टुभाय पञ्चदशाय बार्हतायैकादशकपालो विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो जागतेभ्यः सप्तदशेभ्यो वैरूपेभ्यो द्वादशकपालो मित्रावरुणाभ्यामानुष्टुभाभ्यामेकविंशाभ्यां वैराजाभ्यां पयस्या बृहस्पतये पाङ्क्ताय त्रिणवाय शाक्वराय चरुः सवित्र औष्णिहाय त्रयस्त्रिंशाय रैवताय द्वादशकपालः प्राजापत्यश्चरुरदित्यै विष्णुपत्न्यै चरुरग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालोऽनुमत्या अष्टाकपालः॥
verses.tr: agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthantarāyāṣṭākapāla indrāya traiṣṭubhāya pañcadaśāya bārhatāyaikādaśakapālo viśvebhyo devebhyo jāgatebhyaḥ saptadaśebhyo vairūpebhyo dvādaśakapālo mitrāvaruṇābhyāmānuṣṭubhābhyāmekaviṃśābhyāṃ vairājābhyāṃ payasyā bṛhaspataye pāṅktāya triṇavāya śākvarāya caruḥ savitra auṣṇihāya trayastriṃśāya raivatāya dvādaśakapālaḥ prājāpatyaścaruradityai viṣṇupatnyai caruragnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālo'numatyā aṣṭākapālaḥ
verses.en: To Agni of the Gayatri, of the Trivrit hymn and of the Rathantara Saman is to be offered} a rice-cake on eight potsherds; to Indra of the Trishtup, the Panchadasa hymn and the Brihat Saman one on eleven potsherds; to the All-Gods of the Jagati, the Seventeenfold hymn and the Vairupa S-man, one on twelve potsherds; to Maitravaruna of the Anushtup, the Ekavimsa hymn, and the Vairaja Saman, a mess of curdled milk; to Brihaspati of the Pankti metre, the Trinava hymn, and the Sakvara Saman, an oblation of rice boiled in milk; to Savitar of the Ushnih, the Thirty-threefold hymn, and the Raivata Saman, a rice-cake on eight potsherds; a mess of boiled rice is to be made for Prajapati; the same for Vishnu's Consort Aditi; to Agni Vaisvanara is to be offered a rice-cake on twelve potsherds, and to Anumati one on eight.
